message.content: {"note_claim": "A trade deficit is not a 'loss'; Americans receive goods in return, so calling imports money lost misrepresents trade.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Many economists and trade experts do not believe that trade deficits hurt the economy and warn against trying to \"win\" the trade relationship with particular countries.", "reason": "The page explains that a trade deficit means imports exceed exports (goods and services received), and cites economists rejecting the framing that \"trade deficits mean you lose,\" substantiating the note's core claim."}

parsed.note_claim: A trade deficit is not a 'loss'; Americans receive goods in return, so calling imports money lost misrepresents trade.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Many economists and trade experts do not believe that trade deficits hurt the economy and warn against trying to "win" the trade relationship with particular countries.
parsed.reason: The page explains that a trade deficit means imports exceed exports (goods and services received), and cites economists rejecting the framing that "trade deficits mean you lose," substantiating the note's core claim.
